clues.it: Nino era nella 6ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e nelle Cucine.
clues.en: Nino was in the 6th column, in the 1st row and in the Kitchens.

clues.it: Carla era nella 3ª colonna, a nord di Ugo e nelle Cucine.
clues.en: Carla was in the 3rd column, north of Ugo and in the Kitchens.

clues.it: Vito era nella 7ª colonna e nella 3ª riga, ma non era accanto a delle catene.
clues.en: Vito was in the 7th column and in the 3rd row, but was not beside loose chains.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 1ª colonna, accanto a un calderone e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 1st column, beside a cauldron and west of Dario.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a un gargoyle, ma non era accanto a una botte.
clues.en: Irene was beside a gargoyle, but was not beside an ale barrel.

clues.it: Tea era nella 10ª colonna e accanto a un'armatura, ma non era accanto a un gargoyle.
clues.en: Tea was in the 10th column and beside a suit of armor, but was not beside a gargoyle.

clues.it: Dario era nella 7ª riga, accanto a delle catene e a ovest di Tea.
clues.en: Dario was in the 7th row, beside loose chains and west of Tea.

clues.it: Ugo era in Armeria, ma non era accanto a una botte.
clues.en: Ugo was in the Armory, but was not beside an ale barrel.

clues.it: Olga era in una stanza diversa da Carla e da sola nella Sala del Trono.
clues.en: Olga was in a different room from Carla and alone in the Throne Room.

clues.it: Luca era nella 12ª colonna, nella 10ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Paolo.
clues.en: Luca was in the 12th column, in the 10th row and in a different room from Paolo.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Giada era l'unica persona su un tappeto e a ovest di Irene.
clues.en: Giada was the only person on a rug and west of Irene.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Nino lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Nino's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 6th.

steps.it: Solo Carla può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 3ª è sua.
steps.en: Carla is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 3rd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 7ª.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 11ª.
steps.en: Irene's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 5th, column 11th.
